{
  "target_file": "service/custom_loader.py",
  "strategy": "Replace the unsafe yaml.load call that uses the default Loader with a call that uses the custom AppSafeLoader (which extends yaml.SafeLoader and includes the !env_var constructor), thereby preserving required functionality while preventing arbitrary code execution.",
  "budget_lines": 1,
  "safe_replacement_pattern": "yaml.load(raw_yaml, Loader=AppSafeLoader)",
  "justification": "The original code used yaml.Loader which allows execution of arbitrary Python code via YAML tags such as !!python/object. By switching to AppSafeLoader, which inherits from yaml.SafeLoader, only safe YAML constructs are permitted unless explicitly added (like !env_var). This mitigates CVE-2020-14343 while maintaining the needed custom tag support."
}
